Rebecca Taylor, 26, took control of the Dodge Journey and drove away when the team transporting her and another inmate stopped to pick up food in Albuquerque, local media reported.

articles.title_original: Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65
articles.title_zh: Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65
facts_zh:
Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65
- Published
Simon Le Bon, Sir Rod Stewart and Gary Kemp are among the pop stars who have paid tribute to Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor following his death at the age of 65.
Taylor co-wrote some of the group's biggest hits including Save A Prayer, Rio and Girls On Film.

Le Bon and his bandmates paid tribute, saying "he brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music", while Sir Rod remembered his "dear pal" and Spandau Ballet's Kemp called him "a great player who set the tone for the 80s".

all_titles.en: Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65

articles.title_original: Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31
articles.title_zh: Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31
facts_zh:
Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31
- Published
Egyptian authorities have arrested a man accused of causing a tanker crash and massive fire that killed 31 people on a busy Cairo highway.

The public prosecutor's office said the motorist had confessed to driving at 110km/h (68mph) along a section of ring road, to the north of the old city centre, and clipping the tanker with the side of his car as he changed lanes.
Sources close to the investigation were earlier quoted by state media as saying a high-voltage cable had fallen in front of the fuel truck, causing the driver to lose control.

all_titles.en: Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31

articles.title_original: China reserves right to take ‘necessary measures’ after Trump’s new tariff proposals
articles.title_zh: China reserves right to take ‘necessary measures’ after Trump’s new tariff proposals
facts_zh: Beijing says new levies amount to ‘political manipulation’, while Brazil ‘will not yield to this type of threat’ Trump proposing new tariffs on 14 partners including China and EU Beijing has said it reserves the right to take “necessary measures” after Donald Trump’s administration proposed new tariffs on goods from China and other major trading partners, triggering a global backlash.
Among the suggested levies on 14 major trading partners announced on Wednesday, China is potentially facing one of the biggest hits.
It would face the highest capped rate of 20%, which in some cases will be stacked on top of other import taxes for a total rate of 45%.

all_titles.en: China reserves right to take ‘necessary measures’ after Trump’s new tariff proposals

facts_zh:
Politics and peek-a-boo in Australian parliament as senator brings baby to work
Politics took a back seat in the Australian parliament today when Senator Fatima Payman brought her baby daughter to work.
Payman was taking part in a parliamentary vote on a Digital Duty of Care bill, aimed at holding social media platforms to account for algorithms that surface harmful content.
While the lawmaker was speaking, baby Aaliyah captured the attention of Senator Lidia Thorpe and enjoyed a game of peek-a-boo.
